Worth the visit! We visited Pangong Lake over the weekend and stayed here to experience the star gazing experience. What a wonderful experience and definitely one of the highlights of our trip here in Ladakh.

The guide was super knowledgeable, the telescope is powerful and modern. We were treated with viewing different constellations, nebulas, clusters and all other hosts of heavenly bodies! I also particularly enjoyed learning the Ladhaki folklore regarding stars and constellations.

Thank you for the wonderful stay!

An Unforgettable Stargazing Experience.

Stargazing with you was truly an unforgettable experience. From the moment we set out beneath the vast night sky, I knew it was going to be special. Your passion and knowledge about the stars, planets, and constellations made the evening not just enjoyable but also deeply enriching.

What made the night even more incredible was the way you guided me through the celestial wonders with such enthusiasm and care. You pointed out constellations I had never noticed before, shared fascinating stories about distant galaxies, and helped me see the universe in a way I never had. Your attention to detail and your ability to explain the science behind it all in such an approachable way made the experience not just magical, but also educational.

But what stood out most to me was how at peace I felt in that moment, sharing the experience with you. The conversations we had while gazing at the stars, the moments of quiet awe as we took it all in—it was truly something I'll never forget. There’s something incredibly special about stargazing, but doing it with someone like you made it an even more profound and meaningful experience.

Thank you for sharing that evening with me. It was more than just stargazing—it was a moment of connection, wonder, and appreciation for the beauty of the universe, and for that, I’m truly grateful. I can’t wait for the next time we get to share the night sky together.
